limits: Profile lock serializes this virtual input, not the later public kernel workspace lock; caller owns isolated worktrees with no competing builder.
Distinct-source paths, actual empty target compilation, full kernel ELF comparison and real QEMU boot remain root A01 acceptance duties.
Metadata fixtures are actual Cargo output from a toy workspace using the pinned macro mechanism, not full kernel metadata.
Semantic priority check is a Python transcription of inspected pinned Rust logic; it is not another Rust macro execution.
No independent-host or arbitrary-environment reproduction, no privileged-writer sandbox.
